item.title: Monday Morning, Oct 19
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 19, 2026: a National Guard member shot breaking up a fight on Capitol Hill, a women's health executive order, and the death of NPR's Noah Adams; Putin's proposed summit with President Trump and Xi Jinping, new Russian strikes on Ukraine's grid, a second night of looting in France, an attack on an Australian lawmaker, and Alberta's vote; futures rebounding after tech's worst week since June, with Netflix, Tesla and Meta reporting; World's proof-of-human check for Zoom; Anthropic's data on junior hiring; an Exchange mail bug and an unpatched router Wi-Fi flaw; your X feed with Elon Musk's SpaceX share pledge and a new voice for Apu; Londonderry's acting town manager on council emails and Halloween events; and teens who made sure a boy didn't play alone. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 4 PM Update, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: two killed when a pickup drove onto a youth soccer field in Wichita, an airman killed in a rappelling fall at the Alamodome, early voting opening in Texas, President Macron's address as cost-of-living unrest spreads to Milan and Lisbon, Iran restating its Hormuz offer, an MIT model that lets A.I. see crystals in 3D, Anthropic's new Public Benefit Fund, OpenCode's defenders getting refusals from the A.I. they used to fight back, your X feed with Taylor Swift's fifteenth week at number one and the weekend box office, the Patriots and New England's newest pro football team, and LouLou, the dog an AirTag helped find after an Alaska avalanche. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 1 PM Update, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: President Trump endorses Benjamin Netanyahu nine days before Israel's election, a new NBC News poll sixteen days before the midterms, President Zelenskyy and Treasury Secretary Bessent trading charges on Meet the Press, a sixth day of violent protests in Albania, Canada confirming four soldiers killed at Wainwright, Apple's new App Store rules against A.I. deepfake abuse, Anthropic's first Canadian data center, an actively exploited web firewall flaw, your X feed with the Elizabeth Holmes documentary's record start, a 106-mile Ferrari F50 and a wildlife bridge over the 101, Patriots-Jets and early voting around Andover, and the Milford teens who made a little boy's day. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 10 AM Update, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday 10 AM update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: a record-low approval rating for President Trump in the new Post-ABC-Ipsos poll, Vice President Vance's tough CBS town hall in Michigan, a New York Times report that U.S. envoys pitched Europe on Russian gas, Iran's new defense minister, Pakistan's sudden halt to trade with Iran, a deadly resort fire in Bangladesh, Microsoft walking away from a flagship British A.I. data center, Mercedes-AMG's electric GT SUV, a Codex usage-limit mess and Google's open-source Harness squared, phishing emails aimed at your A.I. assistant and a coffee chain's vibe-coded leak, your X feed with D.H.H. in Shenzhen and an iPhone video glitch, a Whitey Bulger breakfast and an opera-inspired concert around Andover, and the chain of strangers who saved a great horned owl. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
